text: きみ　なにか　きがついた　ことは　ないかね？

structure.jp: なにか　きがついた　ことは

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: なにか　きがついた　こと
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a thing describes that thing; こと here is simply 'thing'. なにか　きがついた　こと = 'something you noticed'.

patterns.name: 〜かね
patterns.explanation: かね at the end is a question in the voice of an older man talking down a little. ないかね = 'isn't there any, hm?'.
